title: A workflow condition on Lead Owner never matches

panels.caption: Lead Owner is <user> never fires; the same rule without it fires
Zoho: Lead Owner is a normal workflow condition
text: Zoho FAQ: "Select Records Matching the Condition. Select Lead Owner and enter the lead owner's name" — then add the action (task / email).
Zoho developer guide, workflow rule criteria example: "Lead Owner is Current User" combined with other conditions.
panels.flag: ZOHO DOCS — not seen on screen

rows.b: Rule with Lead Owner is <user>, lead owned by that user

notes: Value kinds uuid / user are refused (400); owner_id is an unknown field. The screen saves the same criteria the API test used.
Consequence: F-02 (assignment rule sets the owner, then a workflow on Owner) cannot be checked until this works.
